title: Viwakilishi vya Idadi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the number alone in place of the noun with the noun's prefix (Wawili walifika, Vitatu vimepotea) and agrees the verb with it.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Watatu walifika" and one with vitu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)" Kwa nini "Viwili" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiwakilishi cha idadi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino iliyoachwa: watu, wawili.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)" Kwa nini "Tatu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha nomino, hata ikisimama peke yake.
Sita, saba, tisa na kumi hazichukui kiambishi.
Kitenzi hupatana na nomino inayowakilishwa: vitatu vimepotea.
